Individually powerful and resilient, each Havoc Disciple has been molded with unique blessings by the god they follow. Stranded in the Sirius Sector, many Battle Brothers were scattered and left with little chance of survival. These desperate castaways were approached by different gods who offered powerful boons in exchange for their worship. Each god empowered their respective followers, reforging their Disciples according to their will. The Havoc Disciples are now torn between fanatical devotion to their new gods and maintaining their former discipline. On arriving in the Sirius Sector, the Founder’s fleet was scattered and damaged. Most of these ships and their crews were discounted as destroyed, but had in fact arrived safely in Sirius far from the... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/havoc-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Lustbound: This model gets +4" range when shooting and moves +2" when using Charge actions. ### Special Rules Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Furious Aura: This model and its unit get Furious. Lustbound Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Lustbound Boost. Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless. Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Resistance. Scout Aura: This model and its unit get Scout. Steadfast Aura: This model and its unit get Steadfast. Versatile Defense Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense. Read more ### Spells Combat Ecstasy (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply). Beautiful Pain (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with Shatter. Blissful Dance (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply). Total Seizure (2): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 4 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Lust Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Lustbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Overpowering Lash (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred. ### Units ### Heroes Lust Destroyer Champion [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 135pts Champion Heavy Rifle(24", A2,
